features.name: Role-based home pages
features.description: Customized pages designed for different business roles such as business managers, accountants, production planners, and sales managers, with tasks and information relevant to each role.

features.name: Activity overview with operational KPIs
features.description: An immediate overview section on the home page showing key performance indicators so users can quickly see what is happening in their business.

features.name: Fast access to common lists
features.description: Quick access to frequently used lists including customers, vendors, items, and other entities available on the home page.

features.name: Guided tours
features.description: Business Central provides guided tours that show users around specific pages and functionalities to help them get started with the product.

features.name: Document creation and transaction processing
features.description: Important actions are readily available on home pages for creating new documents and processing transactions.

features.name: Performance charts and metrics
features.description: A series of charts on the home page showing performance KPIs that users can flip through to monitor business metrics.

features.name: Navigation bar for department features
features.description: A navigation bar provides access to features and lists belonging to other departments beyond normal daily activities.

features.name: Page and report search
features.description: Users can search for specific pages or reports by name rather than navigating through menus.

features.name: Getting started resources
features.description: Business Central provides guided tours, videos, and articles to help new users get started with the product.

quotes.text: This video shows how to get around Business Central and where to find information in the product.
quotes.why_it_matters: Sets the purpose of the video as a navigation and information discovery guide.

quotes.text: We have similar pages for other roles like accountants, production planners, and sales managers.
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates that Business Central provides role-specific customized experiences.

quotes.text: Under activities, we have an immediate overview of our operational KPIs so we quickly see what's going on in our business.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains how users can monitor business performance at a glance from the home page.

quotes.text: We can create new documents, process transactions, and view detailed reports.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows the main action categories available from the home page for business operations.

quotes.text: we can get to features and lists that belong to other departments by using the navigation bar.
quotes.why_it_matters: Describes how users access cross-departmental functionality through the navigation bar.

quotes.text: if we know the name of the page we want to open, we can also search for a page or report.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights an alternative navigation method for users who know what they are looking for.
